blocks_element.text:
60-Day Smile Guarantee
Every custom dental appliance is backed by our 60-Day Smile Guarantee because your satisfaction is our top priority.

Each appliance is crafted to your unique dental structures with care and precision. We have a have a 95% accuracy rate but just like at the dentist, some cases may need a short adjustment period or a small modification to achieve the perfect fit.
If something doesn’t feel quite right, simply contact us within 60 days of receiving your appliance. We’ll adjust or remake it for free—and if you’re still not satisfied after that, we’ll give you a full refund.

Our goal is simple: to make sure you love your new smile and feel confident every time you wear it.

Damages and issues
Please inspect your order upon reception and contact us immediately if the item is defective, damaged, or if you receive the wrong item so that we can evaluate the issue and make it right.

Teeth Whitening Gel can only be returned if it is unopened and sealed in its original packaging.

Shipping Policy
Upon the purchase of our appliance, we will promptly send you an impression kit along with a prepaid return label. This kit will allow you to create an accurate mold of your teeth from the comfort of your own home. Once we receive your completed impressions, we will begin the process of crafting your final product.

While we strive to ensure a smooth shipping process, we are not responsible for any mistakes made by the delivery affiliates such as USPS or UPS. Once the product is handed over to the shipping carrier, any issues or delays in delivery are beyond our control. The shipping address provided by the customer during the ordering process will be the address used for shipping.

To keep you informed about the status of your shipment, we will provide you with a tracking number. This will allow you to monitor the progress of your package until it reaches its destination.

Please note that while we make every effort to provide estimated delivery dates, we cannot guarantee exact delivery dates due to potential unforeseen circumstances or issues that may arise during transit. Therefore, we are unable to accept order cancellations based on later-than-expected delivery dates.

We recommend that you review and verify the accuracy of your shipping address before completing your purchase to avoid any delivery complications. In the event that the provided address is incorrect or incomplete, resulting in the package being undeliverable or lost, we cannot be held responsible.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding our shipping policy, please feel free to contact our customer support team, and we will be happy to assist you.

blocks_element.text: First, you take your impressions at home so your custom trays can be made, send them back, and in as little as two weeks your custom trays will be mailed to you. blocks_element.text: How is this different from buying whitening gel alone?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The kit includes both the gel and the cu
blocks_element.text: The kit includes both the gel and the custom trays needed to use it properly. The trays are designed with spacing channels to hold the whitening gel in place for better coverage.

blocks_element.repere: Titre H2 · How long do I wear the trays?
blocks_element.text: How long do I wear the trays?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Wear the trays for 10 minutes per day wh
blocks_element.text: Wear the trays for 10 minutes per day when using the whitening gel. Do not exceed 10 minutes per day, and avoid eating or drinking while whitening. After completing your initial 7–14 day treatment, use once or twice a month to maintain results. Avoid hot water and bleach-based products that could damage the tray material.

blocks_element.repere: Titre H2 · Are the trays reusable?
Paragraphe · Yes. Your custom trays are reusable. Aft
blocks_element.text: Yes. Your custom trays are reusable. After each session, rinse your mouth and trays with cool water, let the trays dry, and store them in the included case. Once you run out of gel, you can continue using the trays with Revived Smiles whitening gel refills.

blocks_element.repere: Titre H2 · What is the difference between custom wh
blocks_element.text: What is the difference between custom whitening trays and generic whitening trays?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Custom whitening trays are made from you
blocks_element.text: Custom whitening trays are made from your impressions, so they fit your teeth more closely. Generic trays are one-size-fits-all, which can make it harder for the gel to stay evenly placed. A custom fit helps keep the whitening gel in the right areas for more even coverage and a more comfortable whitening experience.
